notablePrerequisites:
Animar has at least three +1/+1 counters on it.
One of the morph or megamorph cards must be in your hand, with the other on the battlefield.
description:
Cast the morph creature card in your hand for its morph or megamorph cost by paying {0} due to Animar.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When the morph creature enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning the other morph creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
